context: The skill should reject turning one Optional into a list or loop.

checklist.name: Recognizes single Optional
checklist.description: Identifies that name is one Optional, not a real collection.

checklist.name: Uses direct Optional boundary
checklist.description: Uses name.map(...).orElse(...) or an equivalent direct Optional expression.

checklist.name: Removes fake collection
checklist.description: Removes stream().toList() and the loop over a one-element Optional stream.
